name: Vidstack Player
description: Integrates the Vidstack media player for video/audio, with a cookies (privacy) submodule.
project_description:
Drupal Module to provide integration of Vidstack Player for Drupal's video media entities.

 !!! WORK IN PROGRESS !!!

 Important: This module will most likely be deprecated when Video.js Version 10 is released.

 Read this article for more information: https://www.mux.com/blog/five-players-one-future-how-we-re-building-video-js-v10 

 See [#3577815] in the video_js module.
